units.source_text: 乳母出发了，在京都市内是乘车的。

en.t: The nurse set out, traveling by carriage while she was within Kyoto.

units.source_text: 陪行的只有她所亲信的一个侍女。

en.t: The only person accompanying her was a maidservant whom she trusted.

units.source_text: 公子叮嘱乳母千万不可泄露此事，然后打发她上道。

en.t: The prince warned the nurse never to reveal the matter, and then sent her on her way.

units.source_text: 托乳母带去守护婴儿的佩刀，

en.t: He entrusted the nurse with a protective sword for the infant,

units.source_text: 以及其他应有之物，不计其数，考虑无微不至。

en.t: along with countless other necessary things, attending to every detail with the greatest care.

units.source_text: 赠送乳母的物品，也很讲究而周到。

en.t: The gifts for the nurse herself were also carefully chosen and thoroughly provided.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想象明石道人对这婴儿的重视与疼爱之状，脸上时时露出笑容。

en.t: Prince Genji imagined how deeply the Akashi monk would treasure and dote on the infant, and a smile often appeared on his face.

units.source_text: 同时想起了生在偏僻地方的婴儿，又觉得很可怜，因此对她念念不忘，可知前生宿缘不浅！

en.t: At the same time, when he thought of the child born in such a remote place, he felt pity for her and could not forget her, showing how deep their bond from a former life must have been.

units.source_text: 在书函中，也再三叮嘱他们悉心照料婴儿。

en.t: In his letter as well, he repeatedly urged them to care for the infant with all possible devotion.
